title: What happens when default-method conflicts are unresolved
answer: If a class implements two unrelated interfaces that provide the same default method signature and the class does not override it, compilation fails because Java cannot choose one default automatically. The class must provide an override or inherit a more-specific interface implementation that removes the ambiguity.
